title: Three Days a Week
subtitle: 决策选择 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）
meta: 主题语境：决策选择（做人与做事·选择与决定）　|　核心词汇：alternative　|　正文 342 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 alternative 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1973 the power went off at three in the afternoon and my father said there was ① an alternative, which was to close the shop, and my mother said closing is not an alternative but a decision. She said ② an alternative to closing was opening at six, and they did that for nine months and it nearly worked; an alternative, my mother said, is a thing you can say no to.

They ③ had no alternative by 1974, which is what my father wrote in a letter, and my mother said nobody has ever had no alternative and everybody has written that they did. There was ④ an alternative supply of coal, meaning a man with a lorry, and he came nine times and then stopped coming; alternative, my mother said, is what people call the thing they were going to do anyway.

The ⑤ alternative energy people wrote about in 1979, meaning the wind, was nine miles out at sea and cost more than the shop. My grandmother said ⑥ there is no alternative is a sentence that means I have decided, and she said it was the most honest sentence in the language and the one she least wanted to hear; every alternative, she said, costs something you have not counted.

There was ⑦ no alternative left by 1981 except the three days a week, and he said the phrase three days a week is what a man says when he is describing his own funeral. The  alternative he chose, meaning the one he never wrote down, was to keep the shop open at a loss for nine years, and my mother said that was not an alternative either.

The ⑧ alternative I would name, if I were writing the letter, is the six o'clock opening for nine months, which nearly worked. An  alternative, my father said in 1990, is the only word in the language that means both a way out and a way of not saying you are leaving; he used it forty-one times in nine letters, and the alternative was never the coal.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 可供选择的事物；替代方案
B. n. 选择；取舍（have no alternative 别无选择）
C. adj. 可供替代的；替代的
D. n. （可行的）另一条路；出路
E. 固定搭配：have no alternative (but to ...) 别无选择（只能……）
F. 固定搭配：an alternative to ... ……的替代方案／替代品
G. 固定搭配：alternative energy / fuel 替代能源／替代燃料
H. 固定搭配：there is no alternative 别无选择

items.q: there was an alternative, which was to close
an alternative to closing was opening
The alternative energy people wrote about
there is no alternative is a sentence
There was no alternative left by 1981

answers.why: alternative 意为“可供选择的事物、替代方案”，1973 年停电时父亲说有一个替代方案：把店关了。
an alternative to ... 意为“……的替代方案”，母亲说关门之外还有一个办法：六点开门。
have no alternative 意为“别无选择”，到 1974 年父亲在信里写他们别无选择。
alternative 作形容词，意为“可供替代的”，所谓替代供应的煤，其实就是一个开着卡车的人。
alternative energy 意为“替代能源”，1979 年人们谈论的替代能源是风能，它在九英里外的海上。
there is no alternative 意为“别无选择”，祖母说这句话的意思其实是“我已经决定了”。
alternative 意为“选择、取舍”，到 1981 年除了一周开三天，已经别无选择。
alternative 意为“另一条路、出路”，若由我来写那封信，我要写的是那九个月六点开门——那条差一点就走通的路。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1973 年下午三点停电，父亲说有一个替代方案：把店关了。（alternative）
母亲说，关门之外的另一个办法是六点开门，他们这样做了九个月。（an alternative to）
到 1974 年他们别无选择——这是父亲在信里写的话。（have no alternative）
有一批替代供应的煤，也就是一个开着卡车的人，他来了九次就不再来了。（alternative supply）
1979 年人们谈论的替代能源是风能，它在九英里外的海上。（alternative energy）
祖母说，“别无选择”这句话的意思其实是“我已经决定了”。（there is no alternative）
answers: In 1973 the power went off at three and my father said there was an alternative, to close the shop.
She said an alternative to closing was opening at six, and they did that for nine months.
They had no alternative by 1974, which is what my father wrote in a letter.
There was an alternative supply of coal, meaning a man with a lorry who came nine times.
The alternative energy people wrote about in 1979 was the wind, nine miles out at sea.
My grandmother said there is no alternative is a sentence that means I have decided.
